notes.title: 40% Release Discount tomorrow. ARE THE DEVS CRAZY?!?!
notes.content:
Tomorrow, Horror Tales The Beggar releases with a [b]ONCE IN A LIFETIME 40% discount[/b]. Why would the devs be so crazy to launch with such a DEEP discount??!?!!?!?!?!?

Well, first of all, talking about "The Devs" in plural only works if you count[b] my cats Nina and Nus[/b] as devs too. You could argue they are fundamental emotional support for the development, though.

This game has been developed and self published by only me, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45009796]Carlos Coronado[/url]. I've been launching and developing games since 2012 and this is the first time I have been scared with a release. Indie games, specially indie horror games are selling every day less and less copies. If you follow the news in the industry I am sure you are aware of this. The layouts, the studios closing, etc. It is not something happening in the AAA sector. Sales have been decreasing since 2021 for every dev. [b]Average new teenager players just don't want to play indies anymore. Instead they download Fortnite or Roblox and never leave that game. With the passing of the years, this is taking a toll on indie devs. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31819776/0f0df36c8d5ddae103d074abab0e09b37de21513.gif[/img]

[h2]Ok but, wtf does this has to do with a 40% discount?[/h2]

Obviously, It is on my own interest to sell as many copies of Horror Tales The Beggar as possible and I want to make a VERY attractive launch offer to compensate for the decline of usual sales. But honestly, it goes beyond that. [b]My games have never sold a shitload of copies, but they have always allowed me to gain enough to develop the next game. That is success to me.[/b] This is the first time in my career that I don't know if I will be able to develop the next game. And the next game is about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1372450/Iron_Reich/]Exterminating fascist robots in a Half-Like style mediterranean dystopia[/url]. It will also end the story of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1340640/HORROR_TALES_The_Wine/?https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492410/Bootleg_Steamer/&gad_source=1&gclid=CjwKCAjwmrqzBhAoEiwAXVpgorWa6Bco3RlVRwVkKO7lX8cKyS2R7Y03MZCuKhcQZASeumxmEXahyRoCvKcQAvD_BwE]The Wine[/url] and The Beggar. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31819776/581179a59c101532b751820e369fbbc3858dcd0a.jpg[/img]

And honestly, I want so f***ing hard to develop [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1372450/Iron_Reich/]Iron Reich[/url]! That's why the 40% discount on The Beggar. Yes, my games have flaws, they are not for everyone, but each and everyone of them proposes concepts and gameplay that are whatever you want to call them, but they never are generic or dull. [b]My games don't have filler, microtransactions, loot boxes, paywalled dlc content or similar predatory industry techniques. [/b]This may be bad marketing and monetization, but I never want to use those tools. I just want to keep developing these weird concepts and a strong release of Horror Tales The Beggar will allow be to do just that. [b]That is again why the 40% discount.[/b]

On the other hand, [b]during the next year after the release, the game will never be discounted 40% again. [/b]If you want to buy The Beggar, this is the cheapest it will be FOR AN ENTIRE YEAR!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/

[h2]Feedback and reviews.[/h2]

I won't be the first dev to tell you[b] how important day 1 positive reviews are[/b]! If you like the game, please come by and leave a review! On the other hand, if you didn't like the game of course you can leave a negative review :( but[b] I always listen to negative feedback[/b] and it is way, wayyy less harmful for the game if you [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1343340/discussions/]leave your negative feedback or problems with the game in the Steam Discussion forums for The Beggar. [/url]Using this kind of feedback allowed me to update the demo with better mechanics, controls, and bug fixing. [b]I always listen and I am fast updating the games[/b], it really is the only advantage t
of work alone! [b]There is no need to leave negative reviews to gain my attention.[/b]

[i]This turned out a little bit more personal than expected. I don't know if tomorrow I am going to regret it but f*** it, I realse the best game I have ever done tomorrow!

Big hug,

Carlos.[/i]

notes.title: Horror Tales The Beggar releases next week! Play the FREE Next Fest Demo now!
notes.content:
Hello Horror Fans! My name is Carlos Coronado and I am the solodev of The Beggar. 

Next week, [b]Monday June 17th[/b] everybody will be able to enjoy [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/]Horror Tales The Beggar[/url]. Until then, there is A LOT I need to explain during this week!

[h2]Steam Next Fest[/h2]

For those of you who are seeing Horror Tales The Beggar for the first time during the Steam Next Fest, just know it is the sequel of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1340640/HORROR_TALES_The_Wine/]Horror Tales The Wine[/url] and it is a highly high high high horror game. Not your usual horror game at all! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/]Play the free demo[/url] if you want to know why, but essentially The Beggar is a weird mix of space-time bending player skills and hardcore sci-fi with of course horror. TONS of horror.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31819776/0f0df36c8d5ddae103d074abab0e09b37de21513.gif[/img]

[h2]Price and Launch Discount[/h2]

[b]Monday 17 of June you will be able to play Horror Tales The Beggar[/b] and sometime during this week I will announce the price and launch discount. Just a little spoiler: I[b]t will be cheap, and the discount will be more than you imagine.[/b] 

[h2]Duration[/h2]

Horror Tales The Beggar is BY NO MEANS a replayable game. [b]It is a high intensity adventure with no filler or bland moments.[/b] Please don't buy the game if you expect it to be replayable.[b] It will be impactful, with everything 100% hand crafted and tailored thowards being a experience that will last in your memories for years. [/b]In terms of play time it really depends on your skills, but for a normal first playthough for someone who usually plays games you are going to spend[b] 3 to 5 hours[/b] in The Beggar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31819776/c8f1ddebe19a18e033328a8d4faba5efe1bbeda1.gif[/img]

[h2]Steamdeck compatibility[/h2]

Although we haven't got the Steamdeck verified tick yet, [b]the game has been optimized to run at 60fps with dedicated steamdeck settings in the video menu![/b] The best part is you can try it by yourself right now, because the free demo is also optimized for steamdeck!

[h2]Accessibility[/h2]

The Beggar also features a [b]VERY robust accessibility menu[/b]. You can access it anytime in the main or pause menus. There you will find options for subtitles, controls or even[b] totally disable enemy damage[/b]! On the other hand, if you are a [b]hardcore player[/b], activating the "immersive mode" in the accessibility menu will totally disable all interface in the game.

That's all for today! Expect way more news for The Beggar during this week and don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/]Wishlist[/url]! It helps A LOT!

Big hug,

Carlos.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/

notes.title: Free Demo updated! Feedback and Wishlists wanted!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Horror Tales fans![/h2]

You can download the [b]FREE Demo[/b] of Horror Tales The Beggar, sequel of [b]Horror Tales The Wine[/b] in the steam main page of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/]Horror Tales The Beggar[/url]. The Demo features sections of the first four levels of the game. Give it a try, it is free! Don't forget to WISHLIST!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/

[h2]Release June 17 2024 with a 40% discount.[/h2]

Three years have been put in the making of this game. It is a very beautiful moment for me. The final game will release[b] June 17 with a 40% discount.[/b] That means it is also a great time to[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/] wishlist[/url] Horror Tales The Beggar now!

[h2]A HUGE Demo Update[/h2]

The release of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/]Free Demo of Horror Tales The BEGGAR [/url]was a [b]HUGE success[/b]. One of the reasons I launched the Demo was to get feedback and OH BOY, the community did delivered! To everyone that shared feedback: a big thank you. Sometimes I am so focused in the details of the development that some things just slip by. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31819776/0f0df36c8d5ddae103d074abab0e09b37de21513.gif[/img]

After a weekend to relax, it was time to get working again and today I give you the first update of the Demo! [b]In this update you will find new features and refined gameplay.[/b] All implemented thanks to your suggestions :) 

[h2]Important new features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The overall brightness of the night battle against Morvin has been increased so players can read the combat more clearly.
[*] While changing the time of the day, now the current option appears, so there are always three options (Miday, Sunset and Night). Players got confused with only two options showed so I decided to also include the current option. If you change to that option, simply nothing happens.
[*] Grabbing objets is now way easier and doesn't require you to look exactly in the middle of them.
[*] Grabbed objects now appear lower in the screen so you actually see what is going on in front of you while grabbing and charging them.
[*] Some big objects in the boss fight arena like boxes and barrels have also been scaled 0.9 so they when you grab them they do not obscure your view
[*] The idle and walking animations have been refined so while in those states you don't see two floaty hands.
[*] There is a new ingame cinematic in the desert with the drone after losing him in the canyon. If will fly thowards your objective.
[*] The "change time" tutorial now indicates you need to move the mouse up and down to change between day states.
[*] The small fires now emit true light.
[*] The reespawn system has been improved. Now you won't be stuck in some rocks after falling and then reespawning.
[*] The intro cinematic text have been changed to indicate the drone spent 32 years looking for you more clearly.

[/list]

[h1]NEW LANGUAGES![/h1]

Thanks to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1343340/discussions/0/4355621052302998980/]community localizations[/url], we now have support to [b]Turkish AND Korean[/b]! Thanks a lot to the community members Gökhan KOCAMAN and 손승호 for the amazing work! [b]With Portuguese, Dutch and German, we now have 5 of the 11 languages localized by the community![/b] You are awesome. Of course, now you have ingame easter eggs and also appear in the credits. Only French, Arabic, Italian, Danish, Finnish, Greek and Swidish localizations remain to be done!  Do you want to help? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1343340/discussions/0/4355621052302998980/]Take a look here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31819776/c8f1ddebe19a18e033328a8d4faba5efe1bbeda1.gif[/img]

So, that's it for now. This week I'll try to implement [b]support for SFR and aditional DLSS config settings.[/b] Now it is your time to play the demo and give me feedback! What do you think about these new features?[b] Anything you think should be fixed?[/b]

A big hug,

Carlos.

notes.title: SURPRISE! THE BEGGAR Demo releases tomorrow + HUGE NEWS!
notes.content:
Hello Horror Tales players!

Well, today I have a BIG surprise to you all:[b] The Free Demo of Horror Tales The Beggar will release tomorrow 16:00 CET. [/b] The demo features parts of the first 3 areas of the game, when some content cut down to make the demo more compact while also leaving some of the lore mistery to be resolved in the final game!

Releasing this demo SO close to the release date (June 17) is a big gamble for me, but the demo had to be released because various reasons.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/

[h2]Reason 1: a VERY weird and unique game. [/h2]

[b]Horror Tales The Beggar is not Horror Tales The Wine 2.0.[/b] It expands in not just the lore, but the gameplay itself too. Let's just say that The Beggar is highly experimental with some game mechanics you've never seen in a Horror Game. [b]For those of you doubting to buy the game or not on release, you can try the Demo and see for yourself if this is your cup of tea! [/b]
[h2]
Reason 3: Steamdeck ready![/h2]

You can try the Demo on your [b]Steamdeck[/b]! The game features a "Steamdeck" mode in the video settings menu, and I'd love for you to try it if you are a steamdeck owner. Lots of hours have been focused into making an amazing steamdeck experience. Now it is time for you to judge if it was worth it!

[h2]Reason 4: I want to listen to you! [/h2]

After you have played the demo, please come to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1343340/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] of the game and post your feedback! Although the game will be released shortly in June 17, I am a quick worker and if there is some fixing to be done I can DO IT!

[h2]5: Community Localizations:[/h2]

If you love what you see in the demo and would like to help me with localizacion of the Demo and The Full game, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1343340/discussions/0/4355621052302998980/]please let me know here[/url]! We are currently looking for[b] localizations to French, Arabic, Korean, German, Italian and Portuguese![/b] Having also Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek and Swidish localizations would be absolutely fantastic too!!! [b]Of course, your name will also be featured in the credits of the game :) The localization is just 2145 words long, so it should not take you longer than 1 hour. [/b]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1343340/discussions/0/4355621052302998980/]Access to Community Localizations[/url]

Why community localizations for those languages? In my previous experience with other released games, including Horror Tales The Wine, economically it is just not worth it to pay for a profesional localization in those languages. That is the simple and crude truth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31819776/7ac4911e938952dc1932bb579298cc422b6e4eab.png[/img]

[h1]A big gamble[/h1]

To finish this long post. as you may know, the videogame industry is in crisis mode from quite some time. Layoffs everywhere, indie game that sell 0 copies, etc. [b]I have not been inmune to this crisis and the sales of my games have significantly decreased since two years ago. [/b]That why I am betting my gamedev future in one big gamble: [b]Go big or go home. That's why I am releasing a Demo so close to release AND also will feature a 40% discount for release. [/b]The game will never be as deeply discounted for years. 

[i]See you all tomorrow in your youtube and twitch channels playing the demo or in the discussions reading your feedback! [/i]

Don't forget to [b]Wishlist[/b] the game. Big hug,

Carlos

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/

Happy quarantine, wanderers.

notes.title: Free Demo now available!
notes.content:
Greetings wanderers! As stated in the previous announcement, a free Demo of Infernium is now available for download! Let's talk a little bit about it:

The INFERNIUM Demo features a big chunk of the game and will allow you to get 2 skills and two harvesting fingers! The total game features 6 skills and 5 harvesting fingers (and content after you get them all :) )

So, if you are deciding to buy Infernium or now, please check the demo first! Infernium is NOT a game for everyone and the demo should help you decide if it is for you. If you enjoy what you get in the demo, the whole game is more and better!

Infernium is also a really slow cooked game, specially at the beginning. You need to invest in the game in order to understand it so please do not judge the game by the first 4 minutes. Give it time and it will romance you :D

On the other hand, does your progress in the Demo transfer to the whole game? Yes indeed!!

Hopefully with the free demo we will solve the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/Infernium/announcements/detail/1604883330053892230]"Mixed" reviews problem[/url]. As usual, if you enjoy the game, please leave a review and tell your friends about it.

Happy suffering :)

Carlos.

notes.title: Patch 1.3 + Mixed Reviews + FREE DEMO Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31819776/7b08ea446bc41dd737d69d2f8b62c9d9283a6511.gif[/img]

Hi wanderers!

You may have seen a little ninja-update happening in Infernium. What is going on?!?!?!?! It is just a small update featuring small bug fixes, mostly out of bounds bugs in the heaven area and a bug regarding the flashlight. Don't worry, you can still speedrun the game and use out of bounds shortcuts! Only gamebreaking out of bounds bugs were fixed :)

[h1]On the other hand, we need to talk about mixed reviews...[/h1]

Infernium always had positive reviews, what happened to get mixed reviews then? :O

Well... actually... nothing. In the last months Infernium has been reviewed by folks playing just 15min of the game and then giving Infernium a negative review (you can check this by yourself if you sort the reviews by negative and take a look at playtime). Of course, it is only natural to not understand much at 15 minute mark of the game. Infernium is a slow cooked game and the whole New Game experience will last you about 16 hours. On the other hand, there is also an option in the accessibility menu that will give you more hints/tutorials. If you feel really really lost, you should definitely use that!

But yes, Infernium is NOT for everyone and it is always going to have negative reviews. How can we fix that? Easy.

[h1]Free Demo[/h1]

Infernium will get a free demo with a r[b]eally big generous chunk of the game (You will get 1 harvesting finger and two skills in the demo!!!)[/b] so anyone can try before they can decide if the buy or not! I don't have a date for the demo yet, but as soon as the demo releases the game will have a huge sale too :)

On the other hand, [b]Infernium is now at 68% review score. With a couple reviews it could get back to positive blue (reached at 70%)[/b]. If you enjoyed Infernium you could really help the game by leaving a positive review! If you didn't enjoy the game and have feedback, please leave a negative review too! I love to listen to players and try to improve the games afterwards.

And this is all for now, happy dying.

Big hug,

Carlos.

notes.title: New Accessibility and Twitch options!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31819776/a0f2e01a9797ce3206fed727a5196bf6689f6b7e.jpg[/img]

Hi,

My name is Carlos Coronado, gamedev of INFERNIUM. After the release I've been listening to your feedback and I've done something about it! The most important features this update brings are four accessibility options, thought for people who want to enjoy Infernium in a different way than I had in mind:

Now, when you it "Play" in the menu you will see a new button called "Accessibility". If you click on it you will see four options:

No Permadeath, No Enemies, Slower Enemies and more tutorials.

This options are thought for people having a bad experience with the vanilla game and I still think you should not activate them the first time you try Infernium. 

The "No Permadeath" option will disable life lost when dying.

No enemies will turn Infernium into a walking simulator experience. The puzzles are still there though!

Slower Enemies will make all enemies 25% slower.

And More Tutorials will spawn extra tutorials in The purgatory, The Edge Fortress and the Memorandum explaining how the permadeath, skills and light systems works, as well as the Stairway to Heaven.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31819776/b07c13d9a1bc48c3f182df1ddf6ab124877c88c6.jpg[/img]

On the other hand, three more options have been added to the twitch integration and a game crashing bug releated to it has been fixed. The three options added are: sunny day, inverted colors and magic mushrooms. The maximum delay time between voting and triggering the events have also been lowered to 45 seg maximum.


Aside from all this, minor fixes have been added to the game, including gameplay balancing (this includes enemy new positioning and nerfing in some areas)

Remember the workshop keeps growing and growing too! Take a look at this mod by Espectro changing all the flying towels for Pac-Man ghosts!

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1352512190&searchtext=

The patch will also come to consoles shortly.

Remember we have memes and key raffles in the Discord! 

Cheers,

Carlos.

https://discord.gg/53CztrY

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31819776/900cf14ecc2340266e3dab20d291c7d1c15a3b89.jpg[/img]

notes.title: INFERNIUM coming soon, Early Q2 2018!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31819776/1f7221352d0915d73a6da7a6de83e70d0bba14a7.jpg[/img]

Hello Everyone!

My name is Carlos Coronado, gamedev of Infernium.

After working on the project for about a year I can now say it: Infernium will be released on PC Platforms on Q1, 2018! The definitive release date will be announced soon but the aim is end of March or early April. There is some third party stuff that doesn't depend on me that needs to be solved before releasing.. It will have modding support (and a lot of mods made by friends nad myself) uploaded to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/789950#scrollTop=0]workshop[/url] and several PC Master Race only features from day one!

[h1]What Is Infernium?[/h1]

Infernium is, above all, a survival horror, BUT with a twist. It has a non linear level design and is set up in an environment you are not used to see on horror games. Okey, so, in other words, [b] I tried to make Infernium the mix of three pilars; Dark Souls level design meets Amnesia gameplay plus beautiful environments.[/b] 

Aside from that, Infernium is also [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tsvpNZ6ta0k&t]speedrunner[/url] friendly and has [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EMPgU3LpmfQ]twitch integration[/url]. If you are a streamer your chat will be able to vote for events to happen in-game LIVE! ːsteamhappyː

If you want more info about Infernium, please visit [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/789950#scrollTop=0]the community[/url]! I am eager  to hear your questions and answer them!

The game will also be aviable on Switch and Ps4
